scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:main && npm run build:render
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @writing-tools/main; npm run lint -w @writing-tools/renderer; npm run lint -w @writing-tools/shared
scripts.test: npm run test -w @writing-tools/main && npm run test -w @writing-tools/renderer && npm run test -w @writing-tools/shared
scripts.test:watch: concurrently 'npm run test:watch -w @writing-tools/main' 'npm run test:watch -w @writing-tools/renderer' 'npm run test:watch -w @writing-tools/shared'
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @writing-tools/main && npm run test:coverage -w @writing-tools/renderer && npm run test:coverage -w @writing-tools/shared
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:ci -w @writing-tools/main && npm run test:ci -w @writing-tools/renderer && npm run test:ci -w @writing-tools/shared
